title.en: Flora Nwapa · Writing women into a changing literary world
title.zh: 弗洛拉·恩瓦帕 · 在变化的文学世界中书写女性

location.label: Oguta; upbringing and literary reference setting, not a publisher address

summary.en:
Flora Nwapa grew up in Oguta in southeastern Nigeria, where stories, trade and the lake’s spiritual associations later supplied material for her fiction. University study at Ibadan, completed in 1957, and further education in Edinburgh preceded teaching and university administrative work. Her literary career emerged from these settings rather than from an isolated act of inspiration. Efuru appeared in 1966, placing a woman’s work, relationships and spiritual choices at the centre of a novel in English.

The Nigeria–Biafra war displaced Nwapa from Lagos to the southeast. Her later public service and fiction engaged the difficult reconstruction of households and communities. Never Again and Wives at War approached conflict through survival and women’s responsibilities; they should be read as literary works, not transparent transcripts of every woman’s experience. Women Are Different, published in 1986, followed changing opportunities and the pursuit of economic independence.

Nwapa also worked on the infrastructure through which stories reached readers. Her publishing ventures, Tana Press and Flora Nwapa Books, included adult fiction and children’s literature. Sources disagree on the exact founding year of Tana Press, so the atlas does not give that disputed date a milestone. Publishing and teaching connected her writing to other readers and writers. She died in Enugu in 1993. Her life links education, war, public work and literary enterprise while resisting a simple choice between local traditions and modern women’s autonomy.
summary.zh:
弗洛拉·恩瓦帕在尼日利亚东南部的奥古塔长大，当地的故事、贸易及湖泊信仰后来成为其小说素材。她1957年完成伊巴丹大学学业，继而赴爱丁堡进修，回国从事教学和大学行政工作。文学事业生长于这些社会环境，并非孤立的灵感事件。1966年出版的《埃富鲁》以一位女性的劳动、人际关系和精神选择为英语小说的中心。

尼日利亚—比亚法拉战争使她从拉各斯迁回东南部。战后公共任职和小说写作都涉及家庭与社区重建的困难。《不再如此》和《战争中的妻子们》从生存和女性责任理解冲突；它们是文学作品，不能当作所有女性经历的直接记录。1986年的《女人各不相同》呈现机会变化与经济独立的追求。

恩瓦帕还参与把故事送到读者手中的出版基础设施。塔纳出版社及弗洛拉·恩瓦帕图书公司兼顾成人小说与儿童文学。来源对塔纳的确切创办年份存在分歧，本图谱因此不把该日期设为人生节点。出版和教学使其写作与更多读者、作者相接。她1993年在埃努古去世。其生平连接教育、战争、公共工作与文学经营，不能简化为地方传统和现代女性自主之间的二选一。

dateNote.en: Lifespan 1931–1993. Publication milestones use Oguta/Enugu as literary and working contexts, not publishing cities or proof of presence on release day. Tana Press is dated 1974 by EBSCO and 1976 by SAHO; no foundation-year milestone is asserted.
dateNote.zh: 生卒1931—1993年。作品出版节点以奥古塔或埃努古表示文学及工作背景，不是出版城市，也不证明出版当日身在该处。EBSCO将塔纳创办定为1974年，SAHO定为1976年；不设置确切创办节点。

title.en: Tana Press · Building channels for women’s stories
title.zh: 塔纳出版社 · 为女性故事建立传播渠道

location.label: Enugu; teaching and later life context, not proof of presence on publication day

summary.en:
The publication of Efuru in 1966 and Women Are Different in 1986 frame a selected period in Nigerian literary production. Between them, Flora Nwapa combined writing with public work and founded publishing ventures that issued adult fiction and books for children. The institutional question was how stories would be produced and circulated, as well as who could appear within them.

Tana Press and Flora Nwapa Books provided channels for her work beyond the acceptance of a manuscript by an overseas publisher. Children’s stories drew on folktales, while adult fiction examined urban life, war, marriage and women’s economic choices. These books addressed different readers; a publishing catalogue was not one uniform message or a census of women’s lives.

The surviving reference accounts disagree over whether Tana began in 1974 or 1976. This entry retains that disagreement instead of manufacturing an exact foundation date. The 1966–1986 focus is a literary sequence, not the company’s lifespan. It connects Nwapa’s biography to the practical work of making books available, without claiming that owning a press removed every commercial or gender barrier.
summary.zh:
1966年《埃富鲁》与1986年《女人各不相同》的出版，构成尼日利亚文学生产的一段观察窗口。在这期间，弗洛拉·恩瓦帕兼顾写作与公共工作，并创办出版企业，发行成人小说和儿童读物。问题不仅是谁能进入故事，也包括故事如何制作并流通。

塔纳出版社与弗洛拉·恩瓦帕图书公司，使她的作品不只依靠海外出版者接收稿件。儿童故事吸取民间传说，成人小说则考察城市生活、战争、婚姻和女性的经济选择。不同书籍面向不同读者；出版目录不是单一宣言，也不是女性生活的普查。

已读参考资料对塔纳始创于1974还是1976年存在分歧，本条保留分歧，不制造确切创办年。1966—1986年是文学序列，并非公司存续时间。它把个人生平与制作、传播图书的实际工作连接起来，但不声称自办出版社就消除了所有商业或性别障碍。

dateNote.en: Editorial literary focus 1966–1986, from Efuru to Women Are Different; not the lifespan of either firm. Tana’s reported founding year remains disputed (1974/1976). Enugu is a regional professional context, not a verified registered-office address.
dateNote.zh: 1966—1986年为从《埃富鲁》到《女人各不相同》的文学观察窗口，并非任一公司的存续期。塔纳的创办年仍有1974/1976之争。埃努古表示区域职业环境，不是核实的注册地址。

title.en: Doria Shafik · Learning, print and the demand to participate
title.zh: 多里娅·沙菲克 · 学习、出版与政治参与诉求

location.label: Cairo; organizing and publishing context, not an exact home address

summary.en:
Doria Shafik’s campaign for women’s political participation joined intellectual work to collective organization. Her philosophical studies in Paris and writing in Arabic and French were part of a wider search for women’s place in public life. This biography concentrates on the years 1951–1957, when she tried to turn education and publication into leverage over institutions that excluded women.

In February 1951 she convened women at the American University in Cairo’s Ewart Memorial Hall. The gathering became a march to Egypt’s all-male parliament, demanding suffrage, public office and other changes. The resulting promises were not the immediate accomplishment of every demand. Shafik’s Bint al-Nil work also included literacy and economic programs: political citizenship was connected to the resources with which women could exercise it.

In 1954 she joined a hunger strike challenging women’s exclusion from the preparation of a new constitution. This strategy made the campaign visible internationally, while also exposing the limits of assurances offered by political leaders. Her challenge to Nasser’s government in 1957 brought house arrest and the closure of her magazine and movement. Conflict within the women’s movement further isolated her.

Her story therefore involves a collective achievement and a personal political defeat, rather than a simple progression from protest to recognition. Drafts, photographs and magazine copies preserved at AUC allow later readers to investigate the work that repression sought to silence. Preservation is a later history of access, not an additional life milestone.
summary.zh:
多里娅·沙菲克把女性政治参与运动中的思想工作与集体组织连接起来。在巴黎学习哲学、以阿拉伯语和法语写作，都是她探索女性公共位置的一部分。本生平聚焦1951—1957年：她试图把教育与出版变成影响排斥女性的制度的力量。

1951年2月，她在开罗美国大学尤尔特纪念堂召集女性，集会随即变为前往全男性议会的游行，提出选举权、任公职及其他要求。随后得到的承诺并不等于全部诉求当即实现。她领导的“尼罗河女儿”工作还包括识字和经济项目，把政治公民权与女性实际行使权利所需的资源相连。

1954年，她参与绝食，抗议女性被排除在新宪法制定之外。这种策略引起国际关注，也暴露政治领袖保证的局限。1957年她挑战纳赛尔政府，遭到软禁，杂志与运动组织被关闭。妇女运动内部的分歧进一步使她孤立。

其故事包含集体成就，也包含个人政治上的挫败，并非从抗议直线走向承认。保存在开罗美国大学的草稿、照片和杂志，使后人可以调查曾被压制的工作。档案保存属于后来的知识获取史，不是新增的人生节点。

dateNote.en: Public-career focus 1951–1957, not full lifespan (1908–1975). Cairo points identify assembly, publishing and political contexts. The 1957 point is not a verified location of confinement.
dateNote.zh: 公共事业窗口1951—1957年，并非完整生卒年（1908—1975）。开罗点位代表集会、出版与政治环境；1957年的点位不是核实的软禁地点。

title.en: Bint al-Nil · Literacy and political claims
title.zh: 尼罗河女儿 · 识字教育与政治诉求

location.label: Cairo; organizing and publishing context, not an exact home address

summary.en:
Bint al-Nil connected the printed word, education and collective political action. Doria Shafik used a magazine and an organization with this name to address women’s participation in Egyptian public life. Literacy programs and economic opportunities for poorer urban women accompanied campaigns usually remembered through prominent demonstrations.

In 1951 an assembly at Ewart Memorial Hall became a march to parliament. In 1954 a hunger strike challenged women’s exclusion from constitution-making. These actions sought more than recognition of individual talent: they asked who could take part in institutions that governed the nation. Differences in class, schooling and political strategy nevertheless remained within women’s organizing.

The magazine and movement were closed following Shafik’s challenge to Nasser’s government in 1957. This was a disruption of a channel for expression, not proof that all women’s activism ended. Copies and drafts later preserved by AUC make that channel partly inspectable again. The archive allows questions about audience, language and political demands; its survival does not by itself establish how widely a program reached or how every participant understood it.
summary.zh:
“尼罗河女儿”把文字出版、教育与集体政治行动连接起来。多里娅·沙菲克以同名杂志和组织关注女性在埃及公共生活中的参与。为较贫困城市女性提供识字与经济机会的工作，伴随着那些后来因示威而广为人知的运动。

1951年，尤尔特纪念堂的集会变为前往议会的游行；1954年，绝食抗议女性被排除在制宪之外。这些行动要求的不只是承认个人才华，而是谁能参加治理国家的机构。阶级、受教育程度与政治策略的差别，仍存在于女性组织之中。

1957年沙菲克挑战纳赛尔政府后，杂志与运动组织被关闭。这是表达渠道遭到打断，并不意味着所有女性行动就此结束。后来由开罗美国大学保存的杂志和草稿，使这条渠道再次部分可供查阅。档案支持关于读者、语言及政治要求的研究问题；档案幸存本身不能证明项目覆盖面，也不能说明每位参与者如何理解行动。

dateNote.en: Selected organizing sequence 1951–1957, not a claimed foundation/lifespan for the magazine or union. Programs are described as activities and aims; their reach or measured outcomes are not established.
dateNote.zh: 1951—1957年为所选组织活动序列，并非杂志或联合会的创立及完整存续期。项目被描述为活动和目标，不确立覆盖范围或经测量的成效。

title.en: Ahmad Baba · Scholarship, forced exile and the limits of freedom
title.zh: 艾哈迈德·巴巴 · 学术、被迫流亡与自由的边界

location.label: Timbuktu; teaching and scholarly community, not a settled birthplace coordinate

summary.en:
Ahmad Baba belonged to Timbuktu’s world of Islamic learning, legal practice and book collecting. Born in 1556, he studied theology and law and later taught in the city. The exact locality of his birth remains disputed; the atlas uses Timbuktu as his scholarly setting rather than placing a certain birthplace pin. His career makes the city visible through working scholars as well as through imperial trade and power.

The Moroccan conquest of Songhai in 1591 brought a violent political rupture. Baba opposed the invaders and was subsequently deported to Marrakech with other prominent people. World Eras places the deportation after an alleged 1593 rebellion; the atlas uses an approximate 1594 anchor without treating the allegation as established. Forced movement did not end his intellectual work. In Marrakech he taught, practiced law and wrote, including a biographical dictionary of Maliki jurists.

His writing about enslavement needs careful interpretation. The surviving work, described by the Library of Congress, defended freedom as a human starting condition within Islamic law. Yet Baba did not reject every form of slavery: his protection of Muslims must not be turned into a modern universal abolitionist position.

Sources place his return to Timbuktu around 1607 or in 1608. The approximate milestone retains that difference rather than inventing a settled arrival date. He continued writing after his return and died in 1627. His life joins scholarship across the Sahara to coercion, disagreement and the unequal meanings of freedom.
summary.zh:
艾哈迈德·巴巴属于廷巴克图伊斯兰学术、法律实践和藏书的世界。他1556年出生，学习神学与法律，后来在城中授课。确切出生地点仍有争议；本图谱以廷巴克图作为学术环境，不把它标作确定出生地。其事业使人们通过实际工作的学者，而不仅通过帝国贸易与权力，理解这座城市。

1591年摩洛哥征服桑海，造成暴力的政治断裂。巴巴反对入侵者，后来与其他重要人物被押往马拉喀什。《世界时代》将流放置于所谓1593年叛乱之后；图谱用约1594年作锚点，但不把叛乱指控当作已证事实。被迫迁移没有终止其思想工作。他在马拉喀什教学、从事法律事务和著述，包括编写马立克派法学家传记辞典。

其关于奴役的论述需要谨慎解释。美国国会图书馆所介绍的传世作品，在伊斯兰法框架内强调自由是人的初始状态。但他并未否定一切奴隶制度；不能把对穆斯林的保护，转化为现代普遍废奴立场。

来源把返抵廷巴克图定为约1607年或1608年。近似节点保留差异，不制造确定抵达日期。他返回后继续写作，1627年去世。其生平把跨撒哈拉的学术联系，与强制、分歧和不平等的自由含义连在一起。

dateNote.en: Lifespan 1556–1627. Birth locality is disputed and no birth milestone is plotted. The approximate 1594 deportation anchor follows World Eras, which places it in the year following 1593; sources give return around 1607 or in 1608, displayed approximately at 1608. Pins are city contexts, not surveyed detention or travel locations.
dateNote.zh: 生卒1556—1627年；出生地有争议，不绘制出生节点。约1594年的流放锚点依《世界时代》所说1593年的下一年；返乡来源为约1607年或1608年，以近似1608年显示。点位表示城市环境，不是测定的拘禁或行程地点。

They do not amount to a fresh reading of Baba’s Arabic writings. Deportation/return chronology and birthplace limits remain explicit; no universal abolitionist label is applied.

description.en: After the conquest, he was forcibly removed to Marrakech; this is an approximate chronological anchor.

location.label: Timbuktu; teaching and scholarly community, not a settled birthplace coordinate

title.en: Timbuktu manuscripts · Law, livelihood and learning
title.zh: 廷巴克图手稿 · 法律、生计与学习

location.label: Timbuktu; teaching and scholarly community, not a settled birthplace coordinate

summary.en:
Manuscripts preserved in libraries around Timbuktu reveal scholarship concerned with everyday obligations as well as theology. The Library of Congress exhibition describes texts on inheritance, commercial contracts, arithmetic and the social value of labour. Poems could help students remember rules; commentaries and examples allowed knowledge to be taught and debated.

The same collections also preserve the unequal institutions within which learning operated. Commercial agreements concern the trafficking of enslaved people, and an emancipation certificate records a woman being granted freedom. Ahmad Baba’s legal opinion limited permissible enslavement within Islamic law without rejecting the institution altogether. Intellectual achievement and coercive social relations therefore belong in the same history.

The selected seventeenth-to-nineteenth-century focus connects Baba’s writing to later manuscript copies, including objects catalogued as copied in 1733, 1809 and 1858. A copy date does not date the invention of its subject or every earlier version. This is a study of described surviving texts, not a new translation of their Arabic pages or a claim that legal prescriptions show how every household actually behaved.
summary.zh:
廷巴克图周边图书馆保存的手稿，显示学术既关乎神学，也关乎日常义务。美国国会图书馆展览介绍了继承、商业契约、算术及劳动社会价值的文本。诗歌可帮助学生记忆规则；注释与例题使知识能够教学和讨论。

同一批收藏也保存了学术活动所在社会的不平等制度。商业契约涉及贩运被奴役者，解放证书记载一名女性获释。艾哈迈德·巴巴的法律意见在伊斯兰法内限制可许可的奴役，却未全面否定该制度。因此，思想成就和强制性的社会关系属于同一段历史。

本条所选十七至十九世纪窗口，把巴巴著述与后来的手稿抄本相连，其中有目录注明抄于1733、1809和1858年的实物。抄写日期不是知识主题的发明年，也不是所有更早版本的年代。本条研究的是传世文本的已读解说，不是重新翻译阿拉伯语页面，也不声称法律规范证明每个家庭实际如何生活。

dateNote.en: Approximate editorial focus 1600–1858 connects seventeenth-century writing with dated later copies. It is not the beginning/end of Timbuktu scholarship. Copy years belong to particular catalogued objects, not every text discussed.
dateNote.zh: 约1600—1858年为编辑观察窗口，连接十七世纪著述与有日期的后世抄本，并非廷巴克图学术的起止年。抄写年属于特定目录实物，不适用于所有所述文本。

title.en: Mahmudhoja Behbudiy · Schools, newspapers and a public stage
title.zh: 马赫穆德霍贾·贝赫布迪 · 学校、报刊与公共舞台

location.label: Samarkand; scholarly, publishing and theater setting

summary.en:
Mahmudhoja Behbudiy came from Samarkand’s established world of Islamic learning and legal office. His advocacy of reform did not require abandoning that background. Travel in 1899 exposed him to educational changes elsewhere in the Muslim world; after returning he read the Crimean Tatar reformist press and supported new-method schooling. The career focus begins with that journey rather than choosing among conflicting birth years.

His first essays appeared in 1902. Over the following decade, textbooks, publishing and bookselling became connected ways of arguing for education. In 1913 he opened a bookstore and launched periodicals, including Ayina, or The Mirror. Readers were invited to compare local conditions with other societies, but sustaining this public conversation required money and subscribers. Enthusiasm did not guarantee a durable institution: Ayina ceased in 1915.

Behbudiy’s Padarkush, or The Parricide, carried educational argument onto the stage. Written in 1911 and published in 1913 after censorship delays, it was performed in Samarkand in 1914. Amateur performers and teachers helped make theater a new public medium. The drama’s moral lesson was a reformer’s argument, not evidence that everyone accepted the same diagnosis of society.

The upheavals after 1917 transformed the possibilities of public action. Behbudiy was killed by Bukharan authorities in 1919. His career connects religious learning, transregional communication and new institutions without reducing Jadid reform to a single founder, an inevitable national awakening or merely a reaction to Russian rule.
summary.zh:
马赫穆德霍贾·贝赫布迪出身于撒马尔罕既有的伊斯兰学术与司法任职环境。倡导改革并不要求他抛弃这一背景。1899年的旅行使他接触穆斯林世界其他地区的教育变化；返乡后，他阅读克里米亚鞑靼改革报刊，支持新式教学。本生平从该次旅行开始，避免在不同出生年说法间强行择一。

他的首批文章发表于1902年。此后十年，教材、出版与售书成为相互联系的教育倡议方式。1913年，他开办书店并创办报刊，包括《镜报》。读者被邀请比较本地与其他社会的状况，但维持这种公共对话需要资金和订户。热情不保证机构长久：《镜报》于1915年停刊。

其剧作《弑父者》把教育主张搬上舞台。该剧1911年写成，因审查延至1913年出版，1914年在撒马尔罕演出。业余演员与教师使戏剧成为新的公共媒介。剧中的道德教训是改革者提出的论点，并不证明所有人都接受同一种社会诊断。

1917年后的动荡改变了公共行动的可能性。贝赫布迪1919年被布哈拉当局杀害。其事业连接宗教学术、跨区域传播与新机构，不能将扎吉德改革简化为一位创始人、必然的民族觉醒或仅对俄国统治的反应。

dateNote.en: Selected public-career focus 1899–1919. Khalid uses birth year 1874; the IICA anniversary follows 1875. No birth milestone is invented. The detailed theater chronology and IICA support 1914 performance; Khalid’s opening vignette gives 1913. City pins locate work contexts, not exact bookshops or a final travel route.
dateNote.zh: 所选公共事业期1899—1919年。哈立德采用1874年出生，IICA纪念沿用1875年；不设出生节点。详细戏剧段落及IICA支持1914年演出，哈立德开篇概述却写1913年。城市点位代表工作环境，不定位具体书店或最后行程。

title.en: Jadid schools and theater · Making a new public
title.zh: 扎吉德学校与戏剧 · 形成新的公共空间

location.label: Tashkent; one major center of new-method schools and publishing, not the whole movement

summary.en:
New-method schools gave Jadid reform its familiar name, but they belonged to a larger experiment in public communication. Teachers sought organized classes and instruction that combined religious and worldly knowledge. Textbooks, reading rooms and publishing ventures helped carry these practices beyond an individual teacher’s lessons. Samarkand and Tashkent were connected centers, not interchangeable institutions.

The stage offered another setting for educational argument. Behbudiy’s Padarkush was performed in Samarkand in 1914, and amateur groups carried plays to other towns. Performances could raise funds for educational work while dramatizing family decisions and their consequences. Objections, commercial difficulties and colonial suspicion limited what reformers could accomplish.

The selected 1901–1915 sequence runs from Munawwar Qari’s Tashkent school to the closing of periodicals including Ayina. It does not date the origin or disappearance of all reform. Neither classroom innovation nor a successful performance proves that society followed one agreed path. Schools, printing and theater created opportunities for debate whose resources and audiences had to be assembled, maintained and contested.
summary.zh:
“新式教学”学校给扎吉德改革带来其常用名称，但学校属于更广泛的公共传播实验。教师追求有组织的班级，以及结合宗教与世俗知识的教学。教材、阅览室和出版企业，使这些实践超出单个教师的课堂。撒马尔罕与塔什干是相连的中心，不是可以互换的同一机构。

舞台提供另一种教育论辩环境。贝赫布迪的《弑父者》1914年在撒马尔罕演出，业余团体又把剧作带到其他城镇。演出可为教育工作筹款，同时把家庭选择及后果戏剧化。反对意见、商业困难与殖民当局的疑虑，限制改革者能够做到的事。

本条1901—1915年序列，从穆纳瓦尔·卡里在塔什干的学校延伸至包括《镜报》在内的报刊停刊，并非所有改革的起止年。课堂创新或一次成功演出，都不证明社会遵循同一条公认道路。学校、印刷和戏剧创造了辩论机会，但其资源与受众必须不断组织、维持并争取。

dateNote.en: Selected institutional sequence 1901–1915: Munawwar Qari’s Tashkent school and the prewar print/theater milieu through Ayina’s closure. This is not a unified movement’s foundation/end date.
dateNote.zh: 1901—1915年为所选机构序列：从穆纳瓦尔·卡里的塔什干学校，到战前印刷及戏剧环境与《镜报》停刊；并非一个统一运动的创立或终结日期。
